opening.argument: The presentation is a Fishbowl Solutions webinar about Oracle WebCenter technical support, not a request for payment or access without a stated service. It describes support offerings, explains what packages include, and discusses their costs. The access conditions also have a defined support purpose: VPN access is linked to resolving issues on a customer’s behalf, and Oracle CSI access is linked to engaging Oracle support when necessary. Oracle upgrade access and defect or enhancement submissions remain tied to Oracle access. Claims about support knowledge, contacts, faster resolution, and ROI are promotional claims about those business capabilities, not evidence of a different outcome.

citations.quote: Join Fishbowl Solutions for a webinar as we discuss our Oracle WebCenter technical support offerings.
At the very end, we'll talk a little bit about pricing and packaging, so again what's included, what the costs are for those offerings
basic Enterprise support in a sense that we can fix or resolve issues on your behalf if we have VPN access
If granted access to your Oracle CSI when necessary such in the case of defects we will engage Oracle support on your behalf
